manual.automaton_wolves.line2: Within the Trial Chambers, you have found a slightly faded but still legible blueprint. It seems to contain instructions on how to construct a synthetic creature akin to the common wolf!{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line3: This construct is loyal to the person that deploys it.{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line4: Being powered by a thermoelectric generator, it should never run out of energy to move itself.{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line5: The metallic chassis affords it more durability and attack damage than its organic counterparts.{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line6: The circuitry that serves to control it, emulates the basic behaviors of a trained wolf: sitting, following, and attacking enemies alongside its owner.{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line7: Much like a normal wolf, Automaton Wolves can also be equipped with armor, and can have their collar dyed.{0}
manual.automaton_wolves.line8: They can not be healed with food, but can be repaired by using a hammer on them while holding any metal plate in your other hand.
